themes_detail.label: Air quality crisis this week
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints spiked to 8 reports THIS WEEK, a 482% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 1.4 weekly complaints (z-score: 13.68), suggesting an acute environmental event affecting the district.
evidence: 8 air quality complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No Reddit discussions or local news coverage yet—story may be underreported
reporting_angles: What caused the air quality spike this week? (industrial activity, traffic, weather, construction?)
Are residents experiencing respiratory symptoms? Interview affected families and local doctors.

themes_detail.label: Residential noise surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from residential areas jumped to 125 reports THIS WEEK, a 70% increase over the 8-week baseline of 73.8 weekly complaints (z-score: 4.18), indicating a sharp escalation in neighborhood disturbances.
evidence: 125 residential noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 73.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Noise is already the 4th-largest complaint category by 90-day volume (1,075 total)
reporting_angles: What triggered the noise surge this week? (venue openings, nightlife increase, construction, vehicles)
Interview residents in high-complaint blocks about sleep disruption and quality-of-life impact.

themes_detail.label: Flooring/stairs structural complaints spike
themes_detail.summary: Flooring and stair complaints jumped to 10 reports THIS WEEK, a 167% increase over the 8-week average of 3.8 weekly complaints (z-score: 5.21), suggesting emerging building code violations or deteriorating housing stock.
evidence: 10 flooring/stairs complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
287 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (235 alterations) suggests active construction
reporting_angles: Are landlords conducting unsafe renovations or deferring maintenance? Cross-reference complaint addresses with DOB permits.
Interview tenants about accessibility hazards and fall risks in aging buildings.

themes_detail.label: Illegal cannabis retailers expanding
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped to 4 reports LAST WEEK, a 967% spike over the 8-week average of 0.4 weekly complaints (z-score: 7.49), indicating rapid unlicensed retail proliferation in the district.
evidence: 4 cannabis retailer complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No enforcement data available; suggests illicit market growing faster than city compliance capacity
reporting_angles: Map unlicensed cannabis retail locations in Jackson Heights/Elmhurst; how many operate openly?
Interview SBS and NYPD about enforcement priorities and why complaints are spiking now.

themes_detail.label: Park rule violations escalating
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violation complaints jumped to 8 reports LAST WEEK, an 814% increase over the 8-week average of 0.9 weekly complaints (z-score: 5.62), suggesting overcrowding, safety concerns, or new problematic activities in local parks.
evidence: 8 park rule violation complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Community Board has filed recurring budget requests for park maintenance and safety (ongoing unmet need)
reporting_angles: What specific park rule violations are surging? (drug activity, aggression, trespassing, equipment damage)
Interview Parks Department and community board about staffing and maintenance response.
